title: OpenWOP Subject
description: RFC 0165 §B. An issuer-scoped, lane-typed identity record carried as `owner.subject` on RunSnapshot and on the run.started owner echo. With `issuer` in the key, two trust roots issuing the same identifier are distinct by construction. Optional in v1.x; the v2 major requires it and removes the bare `owner.principal` string.

issuer.description: Trust root that asserted this subject: the SAML IdP entityID, the OIDC `iss`, the mTLS CA subject, the API-key realm, the SCIM connection id, or `urn:openwop:legacy` for a run that predates subject emission (RFC 0165 §B.3).

subjectId.description: Opaque, stable, issuer-scoped identifier. MUST NOT be an email address, a display name, or credential material (SECURITY invariant `subject-record-opaque`). Equals `owner.principal` when both are present (RFC 0165 §B.2).

lane.description: The authentication lane that minted the subject (auth-profiles.md). `workload` corresponds to RFC 0154's workload identity; the RFC 0154 `scheme` is carried in `issuer`.

kind.description: Superset of `owner.principalKind` (RFC 0132) plus `workload` (RFC 0154). Equals `principalKind` when both are present.

keyClass.description: How `subjectId` was derived when the lane is linkable (RFC 0163 §A). Present iff `lane` is `saml` or `scim`; MUST equal `capabilities.auth.subjectLinkKey` when both identity profiles are advertised (RFC 0164 §A.3).

actor.description: Who acted on this subject's behalf (delegation; RFC 0154 §B inverted to the run's point of view). Provenance, not authorization. Chain depth MUST NOT exceed 4; a host refuses rather than truncates (RFC 0165 §B.5).
